hook: Thinking Machines releases Inkling 2 Mini, a looped open-weights MoE
hookText: Thinking Machines releases Inkling 2 Mini, a looped open-weights MoE

beats.say: Inkling 2 Mini is a 26.4B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model that runs its middle layers three times per token; Thinking Machines says it leads open models under 100B parameters on DeepSWE v1.1 and fits in about 20 GB.
Most weights are trained and deployed natively in NVFP4.
Inkling 2 Mini’s strengths mirror those of Inkling 2 Small: it does best on long-horizon agentic work and is the best among open-weights models of similar size on most tasks we measured.
